InvoiceCreationDateTime.name: Invoice Creation Date Time
InvoiceCreationDateTime.definition: Contains the date and time the electronic invoice was created.

ServiceDescriptorCode.name: Service Descriptor Code
ServiceDescriptorCode.definition: Contains a card acceptor designated code for the shipping service provided.

IncentiveAmount.name: Incentive Amount
IncentiveAmount.definition: Contains the amount of any incentives applied to the transaction.

MiscellaneousExpenses.name: Miscellaneous Expenses
MiscellaneousExpenses.definition: Contains the amount of any miscellaneous expenses applicable to the transaction.

Insurance.name: Insurance
Insurance.definition: Indicates whether or not insurance was purchased.

NetAmount.name: Net Amount
NetAmount.definition: Contains the net amount of shipping expenses.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Contains the total tax amount for the entire purchase.

SummaryCommodityIdentification.name: Summary Commodity Identification
SummaryCommodityIdentification.definition: Provides the identifier assigned by the card acceptor that best categorizes the items being purchased in a standardized commodity group.

NumberOfPackages.name: Number Of Packages
NumberOfPackages.definition: Contains the total number of packages being shipped or sent by the service provider.

Package.name: Package
Package.definition: Contains the details of the package being shipped.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
